List of Questions for ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on

Total number of questions — 15
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Assistance to private airlines
*106. SHRI C. M. RAMESH: Will the
Minister of CIVIL A VIA TION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether four private airlines in the
country have asked Government to help
them obtaining unsecured credit from oil
companies and airports to bail them out of
the current financial stress, if so, the details
thereof; and
(b) how Government proposes to sort
out the matter with these private airlines,
the details thereof?
Converting domestic airports into
international airports
†*107. MS.  SAROJ  PANDEY:  Will
the Minister of CIVIL A VIA TION be
pleased to state:
(a) the number of domestic airports
being operated in the country at present
which are proposed to be converted into
international airports by Government along
with the names of these airports; and
(b) by when the Government targets to
convert these airports into international
airports?
New FDI e-commerce policy on
e-commerce industry
*108. DR. SANJAY SINH: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the steps that have been taken for
the growth of e-commerce industry in the
country;
(b) whether it is a fact that Government
is in the process of implementing new
Foreign Direct Investment (FDI)
e-commerce policy;
(c) if so, the reasons therefor;
(d) whether any detailed study regarding
impact of new FDI e-commerce policy on
e-commerce industry has been made by
Government before implementing the said
policy; and
(e) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?

39
Subsidy on kerosene and cooking gas
*109. SHRIMATI V ANDANA
CHAV AN: Will the Minister of
PETROLEUM AND NATURAL GAS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the total
amount of kerosene and cooking gas
subsidy given each year is dependent upon
global crude oil prices;
(b) the total amount spent on subsidies
for kerosene and cooking gas during the
last three financial years, as compared to
budget estimates; and
(c) the number of States where there is
Direct Benefit Transfer for Kerosene
(DBTK) or cooking gas subsidy?
Employment generation in urban
areas
*110. SHRI P. BHA TTACHARY A:
Will the Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has taken any
measures apart from skill development,
towards employment generation for skilled/
low-skilled workers, especially in the urban
areas to absorb and reallocate the country's
surplus labour into jobs that are best suited
for them; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
Construction of new airports in the
country
†*111. SHRI LAL SINH V ADODIA:
Will the Minister of CIVIL A VIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) the number of new airports decided
to be constructed by Government during
each of the years 2015-16, 2016-17 and
2017-18; and
(b) the names of the places decided for
the construction of new airports in each of
the said years?
Increase in air safety violations
*112. SHRI  RITABRATA  BANERJEE:
Will the Minister of CIVIL A VIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there have
been rising number of cases of air safety
violations by airlines which have led to
health problems for citizens during the last
three years and if so, the details therof;
and
(b) what steps have been taken by
Government to resolve the safety issues
and whether all the airlines have complied
to Government guidelines?
Small airports in Andhra Pradesh and
Telangana
*113. DR. BANDA PRAKASH: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether there is any proposal to
build small airports at district headquarters
of Andhra Pradesh and Telangana States;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the names of the districts selected
for the purpose along with the details of
the current status thereof; and
(d) the time by when these airports are
likely to be set up?
Privatisation of Pawan Hans Limited
*114. SHRI MOTILAL VORA: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has been

consistently profit making Pawan Hans

and

————
List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday, February 13, 2019/Magha 24, 1940 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Civil Aviation; Commerce and Industry; Home Affairs; Labour
and Employment; Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises; Petroleum and
Natural Gas; Skill Development and Entrepreneurship; Steel; Textiles)
Total number of questions — 160
262
Modernisation of Thoothukudi
airport
1083. DR. SASIKALA PUSHPA
RAMASWAMY: Will the Minister of
CIVIL A VIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has initiated/
taken up  modernisation of Thoothukudi
airport after obtaining 600.97 acres of land
from the State Government of Tamil Nadu;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government has fixed any
time-frame to complete the upgradation/
modernisation of Thoothukudi airport;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Increase in domestic flight passengers
1084. DR. SANTANU SEN:  Will the
Minister of CIVIL A VIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there has
been  increase in the number of domestic
flight passengers in the country;
(b) if so, the details of increased number
of passengers for last three years, State-
wise;
(c) whether carrying capacity of
airports are in accordance with the increased
number of passengers; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the details of steps undertaken for
increasing carrying capacity of airports for
last three years?
MRO services in India
1085. SHRI MAJEED MEMON: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the MRO
Association of India  (MAoI) has urged
Government  for a fair chance to compete
with foreign Maintenance, Repair and
Overhauls  (MROs) that enjoy a favourable
import tax policy of Government;
(b) whether it is also a fact that GST for
importing MRO services to India is levied
at a maximum five per cent, whereas the
same services offered at home are taxed at a
GST of 18 per cent; and

263
(c) despite Government opening up 100
per cent FDI, no foreign player had been
bought into MRO operations in the
country?
Debt of Air India
†1086. SHRI SURENDRA SINGH
NAGAR: Will the Minister of CIVIL
A VIATION be pleased to state:
(a) the amount of debt of Air India and
the reasons therefor;
(b) whether it is a fact that all the aviation
companies in the country are flourishing
due to expansion of air services network
whereas Air India is continuously going
under debt; and
(c) if so, the reasons therefor?
Introduction of` 'Digi Yatra'
programme for air passengers
1087. DR. T. SUBBARAMI
REDDY:
SHRIMATI AMBIKA
SONI:
Will the Minister of CIVIL A VIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has introduced
a programme called 'Digi Yatra' programme
for air passengers;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether the programme includes face
recognition trials to the passengers, if so,
the details thereof;
(d) in what way, it will make the
boarding process and security check, more
efficient;
(e) when it shall be introduced and
whether it will be available in all airports in
the country; and
(f) whether there is any mechanism to
ensure data protection norms relating to
passengers?
Benefits to the lower cadre in
Pawan Hans Limited
1088. SHRI MOTILAL VORA: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware that
the Pawan Hans Limited a Public Sector
Undertaking (PSU) under the Ministry has
released the Pay Commission benefits to
the officer cadre last year itself while
denying the same to the lower cadre  and
contractual employees till date; and
(b) if so, the reasons therefor and the
action taken to do justice in the matter
without any delay?
Difficulties in RCS
1089. SHRI V . VIJAYASAI REDDY:
Will the Minister of CIVIL A VIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) the status of Government's goal of
bringing 100 million more passengers to
the skies by 2022;
(b) how Government is going to achieve
the above target through its Regional
Connectivity Scheme (RCS) when only 16
out of 31 new airports have become
operational by 2017;
(c) whether States are finding it difficult
to provide basic infrastructure and other
amenities at proposed new airports;
(d) whether Government is determined
to open the remaining 15 airports by June,
2018;
(e) if so, the status of the same; and
(f) reasons why just 60 out of 128
planned routes are only in operation so
far?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

Disinvestment of Air India
1090. SHRI HISHEY LACHUNGPA:
Will the Minister of CIVIL A VIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the process of
disinvestment of Air India could not receive
any bidder;
(b) if so, what are the reasons for failure
to attract any bidder;
(c) whether Government is still in the
process of disinvestment of Air India after
modifying the terms and conditions; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and the
proposed modifications being
contemplated to start the disinvestment
